reactions.name: Acid-Base Neutralization
reactions.successMessage: The solution settles into a safe neutral band with a clean readout.

failureModes.trigger: Base is added before dilution stabilizes the acid.
failureModes.playerMessage: Base hit the mix too early. Dilute first, then neutralize.

failureModes.trigger: The bench climbs outside the safe temperature band.
failureModes.playerMessage: The reaction is drifting thermally. Reset closer to room temperature.

reactions.name: Salt Precipitation
reactions.successMessage: Solid crystals form cleanly and the solution clears.

failureModes.trigger: Indicator is added before the base solutions combine.
failureModes.playerMessage: The indicator contaminated the readout. Mix both base solutions first.

failureModes.trigger: The sample cools too far below the target band.
failureModes.playerMessage: The sample is too cold. Bring it back toward room temperature.
